name: The Black Shield

chain: The Shady Rest Inn quest chain

summary: Caz Twosprocket studies the black shield tied to the Shady Rest Inn mystery. One detail nearly escapes notice, and Caz sends you to Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore with what was found.

sections.title: A Strap Burned Away
sections.body: A last detail nearly escapes Caz Twosprocket while looking over the black shield. The leather strap on its back has burned away, yet it seems to have been made for a large person. Caz guesses a tauren. That is all Caz can tell, so you are sent to Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore with the word and Caz's apology for not being more help.

sections.title: What Vimes Makes of It
sections.body: Captain Garran Vimes finds little to go on in what Caz has learned. Still, he says he will keep it in mind. He hopes other pieces of the mystery will fall into place and show more clearly what happened.

faq.q: What does Caz Twosprocket find out about the shield?
faq.answer: The leather strap on the shield's back has burned away, but it seems to have been made for a large person. Caz guesses a tauren.

faq.q: Who should hear what Caz found?
aliases: who do i tell about the shield
